patches.description: Unlocks 1080p50 / 4K50 UHD stream quality, multi-audio commentary switching, 80 Mbps instant startup, deep rebuffer-proof buffering, Picture-in-Picture (PiP), and Live Stream Diagnostics HUD on Kayo Sports (Mobile).
